title: Uniting Iteration Limits for Mixed-Integer Quadratic MPC
summary: Iteration limited model predictive control (MPC) can stabilize a feedback control system under sufficient conditions; this work explores combining a low iteration limit MPC with a high iteration limit MPC for mixed-integer quadratic programs (MIQPs) where the suboptimality is due to solver iteration limits. To combine the two MPCs a hybrid systems controller is developed that ``unites'' two MIQP-MPC solvers where the iteration limits of interest are the branch-and-bound and quadratic programming iteration limits.
